title: SourceRecipe
description: The M2 rung of the cost ladder — a REUSABLE, deterministic recipe for how to reach + read an authoritative source, distilled from a SourceDiscoveryReport so the same source never has to be re-researched by an LLM. It REQUIRES the source's authority (so reconciliation precedence is encoded, not re-derived), a cross_source policy (how many/which independent confirmations are needed before its output is trusted), and watch triggers (when the recipe must be re-run because the source may have changed). It is a method, not a fact — it tells the extractor where to look; the extractor's output is still only a candidate. Deterministic when created_at is injected.

recipe_id.description: content-addressed over (source_handle, fact_key, access); version in metadata, never in the id

fact_key.description: the fact this recipe is a source for

source_handle.description: the source this recipe reads (opaque content-addressable handle)

derived_from_report_id.description: the SourceDiscoveryReport this recipe distilled (M1->M2 lineage)

authority.description: REQUIRED — the authority of this source, encoded so reconciliation precedence is checkable

authority_rank.description: higher outranks lower — a FAQ recipe can never outrank a regulation recipe

access.description: how to reach the source — method, locator, and the retry/rate-limit policy

locator.description: the URL/path/fixture id (no secrets — auth references a vault handle if needed)

auth_ref.description: a vault reference, NEVER an inline secret/key/token

cross_source.description: REQUIRED — the cross-source confirmation policy for output read via this recipe

watch_triggers.description: REQUIRED — when this recipe must re-run because the source may have changed; at least one

parser_provider.description: the parser/extractor provider this recipe pairs with (a catalog adapter id)

expected_output_schema.description: the schema the recipe's read output must validate against (e.g. fact_assertion_candidate)

reliability_score_id.description: the SourceReliabilityScore backing this recipe's trust
